task: Waveform-tape visual/UX fix batch (icons, dynamic bar-count resolution, zoom range/direction, peaks density 8->60, smooth paged playhead, minimap resolution, session-persistent zoom/mode, Play flicker fix, docked-not-overlay PlayerBar, magnifier icons, motion toggle relocated). Reconstructed from dangling git blobs after an external branch-switch/squash-merge stranded the uncommitted working tree; each recovered file was byte-verified and the full test suites re-run.

app/engines/audio_ops.py.summary: compute_peaks_sidecar density PEAKS_PER_SEC 8->60; PEAKS_MAX 100k->200k; SIDECAR_VERSION 1->2 (loader treats mismatch as stale and recomputes). Added PEAKS_MAX_DECODE_SAMPLES decode-cap guard. Max-abs-per-bucket aggregation unchanged.

frontend/src/app/layout/WaveformTape.tsx.summary: usePeaks gains optional suppliedPeaks (sidecar source-swap seam). Detail canvas bar count is now computeTapeBarCount(availablePeaks, duration, windowSec, containerWidthPx) instead of fixed 180 (scales visual resolution with zoom width, capped by real peaks + measured pixel width, floor 180). Playhead position driven by a 60Hz requestAnimationFrame loop in BOTH paged and moving modes (was timeupdate ~4Hz in paged, which stepped). Re-exports TAPE_ZOOM_PRESETS_SEC from waveformTapeZoomPresets.

frontend/src/app/layout/waveformTapeZoom.summary: TAPE_ZOOM_PRESETS_SEC extended to [3,5,8,15,30,60,120]. Added shared TAPE_BAR_COUNT and computeTapeBarCount() (moved here from WaveformTape.tsx to break a WaveformTapeMinimap->WaveformTape import cycle).

frontend/src/app/layout/WaveformTapeZoom.summary: Zoom +/- glyphs replaced with lucide ZoomOut/ZoomIn icons (were blank gray hit-boxes: min-width/height:44px floor overrode the sized glyph). Zoom-in resolution cap relaxed from bar-for-bar peak parity to MIN_SAMPLES_IN_VIEW=4 so all 7 presets are reachable. Dot/native-slider layout uses visPos()=LAST_IDX-i (widest left, tightest right); button logic unchanged.

frontend/src/app/layout/WaveformTapeMini.summary: Bar count now uses computeTapeBarCount(windowSec=duration) + ResizeObserver measured width instead of fixed MINIMAP_BARS=200. Playhead line stroke changed from var(--color-wave-cursor,var(--accent)) (blue, same as window-rect edges) to var(--text-muted) so it is visually distinct from the two blue selection edges.

frontend/src/app/layout/PlayerBar.tsx.summary: Split the single audio-lifecycle effect into a source-load effect (keyed [audioUrl,requestId], sets .src) and a play/pause effect ([audioUrl,playing,requestId], never touches .src) — fixes Play/Pause flicker (old guard audio.src!==audioUrl always failed open, reloading the media element). tapeOpen/windowSec/tapeMode NOT reset on track change (session-persistent view). Fetches peaks sidecar for over-cap clips (TAPE_DURATION_CAP_SEC=600). Motion toggle passed as WaveformTape zoomRowTrailing (same row as zoom controls). New binding rule audio-player.md 5.6.

frontend/src/app/layout/AppShell.tsx.summary: PlayerBar moved to a normal flex-column sibling of .shell-grid (docked), removing the hardcoded content padding-bottom that only accounted for the collapsed bar. Content column shrinks/scrolls when the bar grows instead of being covered.

frontend/src/theme/components/player.css.summary: .player-bar position:fixed -> position:relative; flex-shrink:0 (docked, not overlay). Added .tape-zoom-row, .tape-zoom-icon, tape-region height budget raised (120->220, max 260) with a .tape-canvas min-height floor. .tape-motion-toggle spacing.

flow_impact: peaks-sidecar-on-request flow: sidecar now 60 peaks/sec at version 2; SIDECAR_VERSION bump auto-invalidates cached v1 sidecars. PlayerBar/AppShell presentation contract: docked-flex (not fixed-overlay) and source-load/play-pause must stay separate effects (audio-player.md 5.6) — both spec-documented MUST-NOT-regress shapes.
